name: comp-34
title: Character Limit Input
blurb: Text input showing current and maximum character count.
description: A text input with maxLength 50 displaying character count as 'X/50' in the bottom right. Uses a custom useCharacterLimit hook to track input state.
use_when: Forms where users need to see how much space they have left (bios, tweets, comments).
avoid_when: The character limit is context-dependent or changes dynamically.
a11y: Label linked to input. Counter has aria-live='polite' and role='status'. Input has aria-describedby linking to counter.
